result.instructions: One read-only tool, score_posting, over a frozen job-posting corpus. Its verdicts are rule outputs, not advice.

tools.name: score_posting
tools.title: Score one job posting with the JS3 filter
tools.description: Return the JS3 filter's verdict (keep or reject) for one posting in the frozen corpus, by its key ("system/board/id", for example "greenhouse/fanduel/8055746"). The result lists which reject rule fired and the exact words that fired it, the score, the threshold, and the skill words found. Read-only: it reads postings saved on disk and never fetches, writes, or sends anything. The verdict is the filter's rule output, not advice on whether to apply.
